comment: ROUND TWO — 'THE KING'S SECRET'. Kane jailed (no goal). Mystery = who organises the game. REVEAL: the Keeper is Pelé, the King of Football, rigging the board to crown his heir Neymar by jailing every rival. Ends on a rebellion / Round Three cliffhanger. Fantasy board game = fiction; scores are OUR STORY. VO-driven sync.

lines.text: Round one is over.
The board has been reset.
But this game was never fair.
Someone has been cheating... from the very first roll.
Last round, the board crowned Messi, and caged the great Ronaldo.
Three kings climbed. One sat in a cell. And two rounds remained.
Now the dice rise again. And round two finds a new victim.
Harry Kane. England's captain. A nation's only hope.
Ninety minutes. Not a single goal.
And the board does not forgive.
The bars came down on the captain.
Two legends now share the dark.
But while kings were falling... one man never rolled a bad number.
Neymar. Brazil. Every dice landing in his favour.
Every street, his. Every escape, clean.
Too clean. As if the board itself wanted him to win.
Messi saw it. Mbappe saw it. Haaland saw it.
This game was rigged.
But by whom? Who deals these cards? Who rolls these dice?
Who built this board... and hid in its shadow?
Tonight, the Keeper finally steps into the light.
And the face beneath the hood...
is the King of Football himself.
Pele.
Three World Cups. A crown that no one could ever take.
And one final wish. To see Brazil rule the board, one more time.
So the King chose an heir. He chose Neymar.
And every rival who stood in the way... he sent to the cells.
Ronaldo. Kane. One by one, the threats removed.
The fix was almost perfect.
Almost. Because the King forgot one thing.
You cannot cage every legend forever.
Behind the bars, they are not broken. They are planning.
A rebellion is rising on the board.
One rigged game. One hidden King. One heir who must not win.
Round three decides everything.
The cages open. The legends strike back.
And the cup is still anyone's to take.
But now... the board is yours.
Go to worldcup twenty-six dot world. Pick your three legends, and break the game open.
Free to play. For glory alone.
Who do you free first? You decide.
Like, share, and subscribe. Round three is coming.
